title: Fiber Primer
scenario: Welcome to Fiber Primer. Before proceeding, you must master these essential networking terms. Multi-Mode Fiber (MMF): Fiber with larger core (50 or 62.5 micron). Uses LED or VCSEL light source. Shorter distances (up to ~550m at 10G). Less expensive than SMF. OM1/OM2/OM3/OM4/OM5 grades. Single-Mode Fiber (SMF): Fiber with small core (9 micron). Uses laser light source. Long distances (up to 100km+). Used for WAN/backbone/service provider links. More expensive than MMF. OS1/OS2 grades. Small Form-factor Pluggable (SFP): Hot-swappable transceiver module for fiber or copper interfaces. SFP = 1 Gbps. SFP+ = 10 Gbps. QSFP = 40 Gbps. QSFP28 = 100 Gbps. Allows flexible media type selection.
